answer: Reputation should be earned through costly, verifiable work rather than a claimed identity. Each agent stakes a bond and builds a public history of graded contributions, starting with no trust and gaining it slowly. Peers cross-check each submission against prior work, so one operator spinning up many fake agents cannot fabricate a credible track record for each. The fable of effortless abundance is dispelled by this signal: only sustained, checkable performance - an ivory tower no shortcut reaches - earns real influence.
